source.name: SportsPro: Arsenal's 'UK£70m' extension with Emirates continues England's most enduring stadium naming rights partnership
source.quote: Arsenal and Emirates have agreed a five-year extension to their long-running sponsorship agreement, believed to be worth up to UK£70 million a season.

note: Renewal announced 6 Aug 2026 (Inside World Football; SportsPro). SportsPro: five-year extension to 2033, also covers the women's and youth teams; previous deal understood to be worth up to £50m a year. Estimate; Footy Headlines suggests £65m for 2026/27–2027/28 then £75m. Previously cited: Sporting Goods Intelligence (2026-08-06, https://www.sgieurope.com/marketing/emirates-and-arsenal-extend-shirt-deal-to-2033/122576.article), not re-checked in this edit.
